events.summary: ADTC kickoff — register, clone, GPU credits, pick domain
events.description:
1. Register on Devpost: https://adtc-2026.devpost.com/
2. Clone submission template: https://github.com/Africa-Deep-Tech-Foundation/adtc-2026-submission-template
3. Clone profiler: https://github.com/Africa-Deep-Tech-Foundation/adtc-profiler
4. Apply for GPU credits: https://aghcloud.ai/p/3850810a-8f62-474c-b448-e204d026b189
5. Pick ONE domain (recommend Agriculture or Healthcare — Best African Use Case prize is $1,500)
6. Run the profiler on your actual laptop to get a baseline.

events.summary: SONAR admin — BCG, MoMo, IBM Bob, Mintek, GovTech
events.description:
1. BCG Platinion application (CV + motivation letter) — apply individually, both of you: https://bcg.eightfold.ai/events/candidate/landing?plannedEventId=33rM9beDD
2. Fill the MTN MoMo Mini App registration form + register on https://momodeveloper.mtn.com/ for sandbox keys.
3. Request free IBM Bob trial: https://bob.ibm.com/trial
4. PHONE MINTEK — confirm whether the 2026 Grad Hackathon has closed. https://mintek.co.za/media/news/
5. Read GovTech T&Cs and decide in/out: https://www.govtech.gov.za/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/GovTech-2026-Hackathon-Terms-and-Condition.pdf

events.summary: UNESCO Youth Hackathon submission — one evening, then done
events.description:
Theme: 'Play Your Part: Youth Designing the Future of Media and Information Literacy'. Concept/project submission, not code. Brief: https://www.unesco.org/en/articles/unesco-youth-hackathon-2026
Deadline is 16 Aug 23:59 Paris = 23:59 SAST. Submit tonight, don't leave it to Sunday.

events.summary: DEADLINE: UNESCO Youth Hackathon 2026
events.description: 23:59 Paris time = 23:59 SAST. https://www.unesco.org/en/articles/unesco-youth-hackathon-2026

events.summary: ADTC build sprint 1 — model selection + quantisation
events.description:
Target: a candidate model running under 7GB peak RAM at >15 tok/s on the ADTC Standard Laptop profile (i5 10-12th gen / Ryzen 5 3000-5000, 8GB DDR4, integrated graphics, Ubuntu 22.04).
Remember the score: 50% accuracy, 30% throughput, 20% efficiency, -10 if you throttle above 85C. OOM = disqualification.

events.summary: ADTC feature freeze + full benchmark run
events.description: No new features after tonight. Run the official profiler end-to-end. Record latency, throughput, peak RAM, CPU and thermals. If it OOMs on 8GB you have three days to fix it — that's the point of freezing now.

events.summary: ADTC build sprint 2 — report, benchmarks, 2-min video
events.description:
Deliverables: open-source repo on the ADTC template; report covering problem definition, constraints, design alternatives, tools and why, performance tests, screenshots; video max 2 minutes.
The report is worth real marks — do not treat it as an afterthought.

events.summary: SUBMIT: Africa Deep Tech Challenge ($16,500)
events.description:
Hard deadline: 24 Aug 23:45 PDT = 25 Aug 08:45 SAST. SUBMIT ON THE 24TH, not in the small hours of the 25th.
https://adtc-2026.devpost.com/

events.summary: IBM Bob prep — trial working, workflow problem chosen
events.description: Bob 2.0 trial installed and running. Pick ONE developer workflow to improve: onboarding onto a legacy codebase, debugging, code review, testing, maintenance, or release/deploy. Have a real or sample project ready. Judges want Agent mode, parallel tasks, subagents, document understanding — not autocomplete.

events.description:

Register: https://ibmdevday-bob-platform.bemyapp.com/#/register

https://ibmdevday-bob.bemyapp.com/

events.description:

2026 adds prizes for the MOST EFFICIENT MODELS — that's the ADTC skillset, use it.
https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/rsna-knee-abnormality-detection
